remarks: ENJOY LIFE TO ITS FULLEST! Prime location only a half mile or 10 min walk to the East Norwalk train station, and also half mile to the Maritime Center, trendy SONO area - full of top-rated restaurants, SONO Collection mall, and event-filled Veterans Park (ie. where the annual Oyster Festival is held). Enjoy recently renovated bath, stainless steel appliances, and outfitted closets. Landlord will freshen up the home to welcome the next occupant. Rent includes heat, hot water, and water. Tenant pays for electricity and cooking gas. Unit comes with 1 parking spot (no extra cost). 2nd floor apartment with lots of natural light. Also nearby is Calf Pasture Beach (1.8 miles), mini golf, Sweet Ashley's Ice Cream, and so much more. Pet rent extra $50/month - pet must be approved by landlord & association. Good credit required. All tenant applications must include broker supplied credit check, proof of income, and employment/landlord references. 2 months security deposit and renter's insurance is also required.
